name: openpixo/game-design-doc
title: One-page game design document
description: Turn a rough game idea into a project-owned one-page GDD with a testable core loop, player verbs, win and loss rules, scope cuts, and a small playable milestone.

description_i18n.en: Turn a rough game idea into a project-owned one-page GDD with a testable core loop, player verbs, win and loss rules, scope cuts, and a small playable milestone.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把粗略游戏想法整理成保存在项目中的单页 GDD，明确核心循环、玩家动作、胜负条件、范围取舍和可试玩里程碑。

examples.title: Scope the sample platformer

title_i18n.zh-CN: 收敛示例平台跳跃游戏的范围

examples.prompt: Read this Phaser sample platformer and save a one-page docs/GDD.md describing its current core loop, controls and win rule. Propose one 90-second level with three teaching beats, optional coins and explicit scope cuts; mark proposed changes separately from existing behavior.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 阅读这个 Phaser 示例平台跳跃项目，将当前核心循环、操作和胜利规则写成单页 docs/GDD.md。提出一个 90 秒关卡，包含三个教学段、可选金币和明确的范围取舍，并区分提议的改动与现有行为。

examples.title: Turn an idea into a first playable

title_i18n.zh-CN: 把想法整理成首个可试玩版本

examples.prompt: Use this Godot 2D project as the starting point for a tiny game about carrying a lantern through dark rooms. Save docs/GDD.md with the loop, four player verbs at most, win/lose/retry rules and one-room acceptance cases. Keep the first slice achievable with placeholder art and do not implement it yet.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 以这个 Godot 2D 项目为起点，设计一个提灯穿过黑暗房间的小游戏。将核心循环、最多四个玩家动作、胜负与重试规则、单房间验收用例保存到 docs/GDD.md。首个版本只用占位素材，暂不实现代码。

examples.title: Cut an oversized prototype plan
examples.prompt: Compare the game's existing design notes with the playable project. Rewrite docs/GDD.md around one complete 2D level, list what is already implemented, move crafting and progression out of the first slice, and add observable acceptance cases for success, failure and restart.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 对照现有设计笔记和可运行项目，把 docs/GDD.md 收敛为一个完整的 2D 关卡。列出现已实现的内容，将制作系统和长期成长移出首个版本，并添加成功、失败和重试的可观察验收用例。
